correctness.rationale: Starting from the published two-equation 4-periodic boundary-law system, the exchange-symmetric coordinates s=(a+b)/2 and d=(a-b)/2 give analytic equations in u=d^2. At the second shared-root value tau_2(k), the (s,tau) Jacobian equals 2(k-1)[k-(k+1)x^2]/(x[k-(k-1)x^2]) and is positive. The implicit-function theorem yields a unique local branch tau(u)=tau_2+C_k u+O(u^2). The displayed C_k is positive because x<k/(k+1), so the unequal pair occurs only for tau>tau_2 locally and has the claimed square-root amplitude. The accompanying replay is corroborative, not the basis of the infinite proof.
